description: Hannah Pingree, former Speaker of the Maine House and candidate for Governor, has earned the endorsement of Maine Conservation Voters Action Fund (MCVAF), a milestone that reflects the growing momentum behind her campaign. MCV, Maine’s leading environmental organization, works to elect leaders who will protect the state’s natural resources, fight climate change, and invest in affordable clean energy — making their endorsement a major recognition of Hannah’s record and vision for a sustainable Maine.
